snippet.title: The Witch's Bakery - Release Teaser (Opening Song)
snippet.description:
We've always dreamed of having an opening for our game. And here it is.🥹 

It features a beautiful original song "Le Coeur de Paris", lit. The Heart of Paris, composed for the game by @CecileCorbelOfficial (she's worked on Studio Ghibli's Arrietty!!!). You can listen to it on Spotify! https://open.spotify.com/album/01LwWO5n7YDbWSwYhlDcyX

As you can see, we've moved the release from Q2 to August, which is right around the corner!
It's taken us a bit longer than anticipated and we didn't want to commit to date in Q2 that may not be feasible and then delay. But then, Mid-June through July is not so comfy to launch a game due to highly competitive Steam and console events. (there are a loooot of much, much bigger fishes than us there)😅

So we decided on August to be safer! Sorry for the delay, we know how much you've been waiting!! 🥺

We're so happy for all your support!! We can't wait to get the game in your hands! And if you haven't tried it yet, our demo is on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967950/The_Witchs_Bakery/

An immense shower of thanks, love and admiration to Gary Vanaka and EODE for their amazing work on the animation!!
And — our dream come true — @BrigitteLecordierYT for lending her voice to Orio and Lunne's mom!! Thank you so much (omgggggg)
And Rui (https://www.instagram.com/ruichxnn/) for being the perfect Lunne!! 
And Margaux Rinaldi for voicing the little girl!

"Le ciel a promis d'être bleu~~" @SilverLiningIntRetail, thank you for being with us on this adventure!

#indiegame #cozygames
